evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The aphorism frames rehearsal as the condition for genuinely possessing a capability — conservation (security/stability of having the rollback) and competence (mastery through rehearsal) co-occur.
Asserting a fixed cadence appeals to conservation — regularity and stability as the good.
Naming an owner assigns personal responsibility for the capability — competence as the appealed-to good of having a named accountable party.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNotPossessed
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the text equating possession of a capability with having rehearsed it — making rehearsal the proof of ownership?
